entity: World Bank Reserves Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: World Bank's Reserves Advisory and Management Program (RAMP)
detail: The Central Bank of Somalia's own newsletter states that CBS became a member of the World Bank's Reserves Advisory and Management Program at the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings, and that through RAMP CBS gains access to technical support, advisory services and a network of global institutions; the source describes advice and technical support, not management of assets.
source_title: CBS Newsletter, Issue 004 (Central Bank of Somalia)

entity: World Bank Reserves Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The National Bank of Georgia's own news item describes ongoing cooperation with the World Bank RAMP mission, covering the update of the foreign exchange reserves investment strategy and the enhancement of the gold management policy, with the Governor thanking the RAMP team for their technical assistance and continuous support; the source describes technical assistance and advice, not management of assets.
source_title: Natia Turnava Meets with World Bank RAMP Mission (National Bank of Georgia)

detail: The Bank of Papua New Guinea's annual report names Pictet among the external managers running part of its reserves portfolio, stating that Pictet recorded the weakest relative performance while DWS and BlackRock delivered the strongest results for the year; this is management of assets against the FTSE Russell Government Bond Index 1-3 Years USD Hedged benchmark.
source_title: Annual Report 2024 (Bank of Papua New Guinea)

detail: The Bank of Papua New Guinea's annual report names DWS among the external managers running part of its reserves portfolio, stating that DWS and BlackRock delivered the strongest results for the year while Pictet recorded the weakest relative performance; this is management of assets against the FTSE Russell Government Bond Index 1-3 Years USD Hedged benchmark.
source_title: Annual Report 2024 (Bank of Papua New Guinea)

detail: The Bank of Papua New Guinea's annual report names BlackRock among the external managers running part of its reserves portfolio, stating that DWS and BlackRock delivered the strongest results for the year; this is management of assets against the FTSE Russell Government Bond Index 1-3 Years USD Hedged benchmark.
source_title: Annual Report 2024 (Bank of Papua New Guinea)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that the Central Bank of Eswatini moved its SDR-based portfolio to Crown Agents Investment Management in October 2023 after trying internal management, and that CAIM manages that portfolio while also training bank staff through regular calls, visits at least twice a year and an annual workshop; this is management of assets plus training.
as_of: portfolio moved to CAIM in October 2023; profile published 2026
source_title: Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that Crown Agents Investment Management manages about 95 percent of the Central Bank of the Solomon Islands' SDR allocation and has offered the bank online training on investment reporting and portfolio performance; this is management of assets plus training.
source_title: Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that Crown Agents Investment Management manages the Bank of Jamaica's SDR investments, which began at 250 million US dollars and have since doubled, and that the Bank of Jamaica gave CAIM discretion over how to invest them; this is management of assets.
source_title: Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that Amundi won a mandate from the Central Bank of Colombia (Banrep) in 2023 as one of eight outside managers, running an active fixed income programme for 1.7 billion US dollars of assets covering Treasuries, mortgage-backed securities and G10 currencies, and that the central bank was impressed by Amundi's knowledge-transfer proposal when screening managers; this is management of assets.
source_title: Asset manager: Amundi (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that State Street Global Advisors holds an equity mandate for the Czech National Bank that was increased to 7.5 billion US dollars, with the CNB's executive director of risk management saying the bank has retained the equity mandate since 2007, and that SSGA also offers the CNB perspectives when it considers alternatives to its current reserve strategies; this is management of assets plus advice.
as_of: mandate held since 2007; profile published 21 January 2019
source_title: Asset manager of the year: State Street Global Advisors (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that BlackRock is an outside manager for the equities and corporate parts of the Bank of Israel's portfolio, that it helped build the bank's strategic asset allocation methodology and still runs an independent annual allocation review the bank considers in its decisions, and that the Bank of Israel is a long-term client; this is management of assets plus advice.
as_of: activity described for 2017; profile published 29 January 2018
source_title: Asset manager of the year: BlackRock (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that the Bank of Lithuania uses BlackRock's ETF services and that its staff have attended BlackRock's training sessions for central banks, which the bank's head of asset allocation called very useful; the source describes use of products and training, not a management mandate.
as_of: activity described for 2017; profile published 29 January 2018
source_title: Asset manager of the year: BlackRock (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's global custodian award profile states that the Bank of Botswana's deputy governor praised Northern Trust's service on performance measurement and attribution and on building the central bank's capacity, and that Northern Trust runs training for bank staff on benchmark construction and fixed-income investment; the source describes reporting services, capacity building and training, not management of assets.
source_title: Global custodian of the year: Northern Trust (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's global custodian award profile states that the Bank of Uganda uses Northern Trust services for compliance, performance and risk sensitivity analysis, that Northern Trust helped it build a dashboard for overseeing its external asset managers alongside monthly audited reports, and that it supported a redesign of the bank's strategic asset allocation system; the source describes analytical and oversight services and advice, not management of assets.
source_title: Global custodian of the year: Northern Trust (Central Banking)

detail: Central Banking's global custodian award profile states that BNY Mellon signed a deal with the National Bank of Cambodia, which holds around 11 billion US dollars in foreign exchange reserves, and that the head of the NBC's reserve management team says the system lets the bank produce all kinds of risk and accounting reports and that the NBC values BNY Mellon's staff training programme; the source describes reporting systems and training, and does not state that BNY Mellon manages the reserves.
source_title: Global custodian of the year: BNY Mellon (Central Banking)

detail: The Bank of Sierra Leone's audited financial statements list the Bank's contribution to the Stabilization and Cooperation Fund, of NLe 63.59 million, among its foreign assets and state that the fund is managed by the West African Monetary Institute, with the balance held at the Bank of Ghana; this is management of a pooled fund in which the central bank holds a foreign asset.
source_title: Financial Statements 2024 (Bank of Sierra Leone)

detail: Central Banking's 2026 awards announcement gives its partner initiative award to Amundi and the Latin American Reserve Fund (Flar) for a jointly developed ESG-aligned fixed-income ETF for central banks, and names the Central Bank of Uruguay among the central bank clients; the source describes a fund product the central bank invests in, not a discretionary mandate to manage its reserves.
source_title: Central Banking Awards 2026: first winners announced (Central Banking)
